cells: G01 Entry and household setup
S07 S23 S24; onboard/profile/household

Atomic home-context transition, reliable household read/write, context-bound backfill, civic anonymous entry, recoverable request outcomes. Prove failed utility match cannot retain the previous home's utility.
T01 Today overview
S01 S02 S03 S04 S05; daily/history
Evidence times and scope, coverage, method version, compatible-change response, truthful score/contribution semantics, linked action summary. No invented factor score.
T02 Air quality
S01 S02; daily/history/map
Pollutant/area/station distinctions, permitted history, forecast intervals, source-basis comparison, Map and Plan evidence links. Test area maxima versus station data.
T03 UV
S02 S05; UV window/history
Hourly periods and gaps, actual valid times and peak-window basis, preparation actions. Test all-low, all-missing and incomplete windows separately.
T04 Pollen
S04; three existing types
Actual daily forecast horizon, type-specific series and permissions for retained history/exports. Resolve Google storage/display gate before expansion.
T05 Mold and moisture
S03 S22 S24; proxy/Learn
Reviewed proxy inputs/version, missing-value handling, private room humidity/leak records and follow-up. No spore or image-diagnosis claim.
T06 Today household guidance
Conditions plus household/Learn
Multiple applicable reviewed notes, evidence binding, deterministic priority and canonical action dedupe. Category changes cannot alter measurements.
H01 Homeguard overview
S06 S07 S08 S09; home-guard
Coverage explanation plus owned tests/actions/maintenance summaries. Private-water no result cannot become a healthy reading.
H02 Water and PFAS
S06 S07 S22; water evidence
Complete sample/provenance import, analyte aliases, tested/nondetect coverage, threshold versions, subscriptions, utility correction and private-well workflow.
H03 Radon
S08 S22 S24; county zone
Owned test timeline, collection duration/method/unit, confirmed transcription and reviewed follow-up; pending-test reminders respect real records.
H04 Lead and plumbing
S09 S22 S24; year estimate
Versioned inventory, property-specific document records, separate water sample evidence, home-year correction and outreach. No address material inferred from totals.
H05 Home household guidance
Household/home/Learn
Selected-category applicability with related owned tasks/tests; no named-person database. Removed-category links return general guidance without deleting history.
H06 Tests and records
Structured tests/results, correction revisions, private attachments, quarantine/scan, interpretation gates and export/delete. Unknown units allow uninterpreted storage, not comparison.
H07 Maintenance and moisture
S22 S24; action templates
Assets, meter/room observations, recurrence mode, completion records, instructions and shared Plan actions. No inferred filter efficacy.
H08 Household summary
Existing daily/home/household
Authorized selected record composition, omissions manifest, local or short-lived private export, sensitive-field preview. No default public URL.
F01 Food and Garden hub
Optional interest preferences, coverage-aware summary, saved records and links. General use works without a site or consumption log.
F02 Fish and waterways
Reviewed full advisory rules, waterbody/species/audience lookup, overlapping rules, version watches; optional private catch/consumption CRUD. Quarantine conflicting raw fields.
F03 Garden workspace
S18 S22 S24, applicable S17
Private sites, independent irrigation context, tests/observations, known/unknown summary and advice preparation. Old samples keep their original site/source version.
F04 Food evidence and notices
S12 S14 S22, applicable S13
Separate study/sample/recall/local-notice records, scope matching, update/termination states, source-linked action and optional private report. No fabricated local food score.
F05 Grower support
Reviewed service/programme catalogue, eligibility and source revisions, inquiry/checklist/reference records, test and follow-up links. No grant or lab booking promise.
F06 Water stewardship
Categorical county history, utility crosswalk/status and reviewed restriction text, subscriptions and optional meter/bill usage records. Compare compatible periods only.
A01 Act overview
Existing volunteer/map/home/district
Reviewed deterministic recommendations, relevant opportunities/projects and saved participation summary. Do not create a second task system.
A02 Organizations
S20; volunteer directory
Stable reviewed organizer IDs, service areas, reporting-outdated flow and archived state; distinguish query failure from no matching organizations.
A03 Opportunities
Versioned event catalogue, filters, cancellations, participation lifecycle, Plan link and reminder. Opening registration is not registration.
A04 Guided projects
Reviewed project templates, prerequisites/safety, shared parent/child actions, progress and follow-up. No unmeasured cleanup or health benefit totals.
A05 Outreach
Public evidence plus existing recipient modes
Versioned source-bound drafts, independent recipient edits, optional private saved drafts with retention choice, user-reported sent/reply and Plan follow-up. No automatic send.
A06 Field observations
Private factual observations/photos, precise/coarse location choice, sanitized reporting preview/export and external handoff states. No public contamination feed.
M01 Map shell
S07 S10 S11 S23; map route
Production layer capability/coverage, query bounds, selection lookup, accessible list pagination, source dates and safe public cache. Preview geometry is not deployment proof.
M02 Water map
S06 S07; water layer
Sample quarter/detail/query contracts, non-detect/tested metadata, per-compound coverage, utility boundary/source distinction and follows. Density is not exposure.
M03 Other map layers
S01 S08 S10 S11; optional S13 S15 S16
Layer-specific evidence, CRS/geometry checks, facility labels, station dates and honest failure. Optional sample/advisory overlays remain gated.
M04 Public comparison
Published normalized evidence
Comparable analyte/unit/matrix/method/time rules and an explicit incompatibility result. Missing cannot rank as best.
M05 District evidence
S06 S07 S10 S11; district view
Versioned geometry/aggregates, defined mapped/tested denominators and partial-population flags, public export with no household fields.
P01 Your Week
S24; shared actions
Bounded agenda/unscheduled reads, occurrences, timezone handling, filters, one-way calendar export and canonical records. Cancellation updates every view.
P02 Shared actions
S22 S24; current recommendations
Action CRUD, recommendation dispositions, versioned evidence, idempotency, conflicts, lifecycle, parent steps, occurrence and reminder transactions.
P03 Outdoor planning
Normalized per-factor forecast capability, planning location/context, chosen interval, preparation tasks, optional expiring change watch. Never auto-reschedule.
P04 Journal
S24; journal/history/retrospective
Real date/vocabulary validation, all-time first-use read, safe whole-entry revisions, create-if-absent batch and per-date outcomes, backfill status.
P05 Patterns and history
Authorized Journal plus permitted history
Versioned logged-day denominator/category analysis, acquisition-basis exclusions, counts and insufficient-evidence state. No causal or clinical claims.
P06 Seasonal review
Existing summary plus S24
Consistent analysis version and owned action/test/participation joins; season identity, dismissals and summary deep links. Separate activity from measured change.
X01 Learn and sources
S22 plus selected evidence
Reviewed topic index/search, locale/version, contextual source bindings, source detail and withdrawn/unavailable states. No arbitrary web search required.
X02 Luna
Existing assistant/RAG plus S24
Effective capabilities/consent, authorized selected-record context, bounded conversation, deletion and single-use confirmed action proposals. Verify corpus rights and citation support.
X03 Alerts and watches
Existing alerts/push, applicable sources
Entity subscriptions, channel-specific preference migration, durable source events/outbox, retries/quiet hours/expiry and correct unread pagination/count.
X04 Settings
Existing profile/household/preferences
Atomic revisioned edits, interests/new feature preferences, locale and home transition, truthful data/export/delete/recovery controls. No invisible loss of categories.
X05 Privacy and recovery
S24; auth/account
Supported optional recovery, file/row/job deletion orchestration, export manifests, retention and restore drills. Anonymous session replacement is not recovery.
X06 Accessibility and offline
Existing frontend caches plus S24
Identity-scoped permitted caches, explicit stale states, idempotent draft replay if enabled, bounded payloads and safe service-worker policy. No silent sensitive offline storage.
X07 Source operations
All enabled external sources
Operator roles, registry, acquisition/review/publication, translations, source health, bounded resumable jobs, spend controls, rollback and correction delivery.

cells: Identity and household
Anonymous Supabase sessions, verified API identity, seven presence categories, profile home details
Reuse ownership and low-friction onboarding. Recovery of a rejected session currently creates a new anonymous identity; it does not recover the old household's records.
Today
Daily readings, source-specific failure handling, score, factor severities, household wording, saved history
Extend observation metadata and forecasts. Do not rebuild the current daily pipeline as a separate feature.
Homeguard
Water contaminant detail, county radon estimate, lead building-era estimate, private-water testing guidance, deterministic action recommendations
Add saved records and follow-through while retaining all existing source distinctions.
Journal
Entries by date and household category, history, retrospective entries, findings, season summaries
Preserve these capabilities and correct comparison semantics before presenting stronger patterns.
Map
Cached water, radon, air monitor, facilities, and district layers
Reuse data and geography. Map is not currently a continuous contamination measurement surface.
Act
Public organization directory, cause and county matching
Extend into opportunities and participation. An organization entry is not an event feed.
Luna
Curated-source retrieval, cited answers, household context, diagnostic refusal, rate limits
Add explicit privacy capabilities, selected-record context, conversation handling, and confirmed action proposals.
Notifications
Alert inbox, read/dismiss handling, five preference groups, browser push, deduplication
Extend entity subscriptions and scheduled reminders instead of creating a second notification stack.
Account deletion
Verified-session deletion through the auth user with database cascades
Extend coverage to every new table, attachment, conversation record, and queued job.
`/api/onboard` POST
`address`, optional `water_source`, `home_year`, `request_id`; geocodes, matches service area, stores approximate location, returns location/utility and request marker, starts 28-day history backfill
Session supplies owner; legacy `profile_id` must match. Preserve request-outcome reconciliation. Current `request_id` is a stored marker, not a full idempotency transaction.
`/api/profile` GET and PATCH
Reads onboarding flags, home/profile and seven household booleans; PATCH accepts `water_source` and/or `home_year`
Keep existing field names and null behavior. Renter and locale writes currently belong to household PUT, not profile PATCH.
`/api/household` GET and PUT
Reads composition, renter mode and locale; PUT replaces the seven booleans and optionally writes `renter_mode`, `locale`
Omitted booleans become false. Preserve full replacement or add an explicitly separate partial-update contract. Current bands/preferences writes are not one transaction.
`/api/daily-score` GET
Optional `lat`, `lng`, `fresh=1`, legacy matching `profile_id`; returns `air`, `uv`, `pollen`, `mold`, `score`, `retrieved_at`, `cached`
Other-point lookup does not write home history. Current own-location cache lasts one hour and provider refresh is limited per household. Extend source times without renaming current fields.
`/api/home-guard` GET
Profile defaults with county, utility, water-source and home-year overrides; returns `radon`, `water`, `score`, `lead`, `action_plan`, `breakdown`, `assembled_at`
Overrides allow public context exploration; do not expose another household's private tests through them. Keep private-water/no-match/lookup-failed distinctions.
`/api/history` GET
`days` defaults to 90 and is capped at 365 when used, or `from`, `to`; newest stored row per household date becomes a history point
Owner scoped. Explicit ranges currently need stronger validation/bounds. Add retained source/basis metadata before richer comparisons.
`/api/journal` GET, POST and DELETE
GET date range; POST whole date/category record: `entry_date`, `band`, `symptoms`, `severity`, `note`, `retrospective`, `possibly_illness`; DELETE `id` or `all=true`
Unique date/category upsert. Preserve all fields during edit or Undo. DELETE returns actual row count. New revision checking must coexist with legacy upsert.
`/api/journal/findings` GET
Current household-level 90-day analysis and readiness/counts
No current category-filter contract. New category analysis must compute scoped findings, not relabel existing results.
`/api/journal/retrospective` POST
`dates` array, at most 62 accepted dates; returns environmental comparison across the applicable months
This comparison call does not save Journal entries. Separate entry saves need partial-batch reporting and retry reconciliation.
`/api/journal/summary` GET
Optional `season`, `year`, otherwise last ended season; returns seasonal descriptive summary
Preserve winter-year definition. Extend with action/test participation records without changing old analysis meaning silently.
`/api/map` GET
`layer` accepts water, radon, facilities or air; optional water `quarter`; cached layers or live rebuild
Public-reference layer cached without household fields. Quarter response uses samples in that quarter, not a cumulative plume.
`/api/district` GET
NC08 aggregate plus the authenticated household's county context
Shared aggregate and per-household county enrichment must remain separate cache scopes. Geography vintage requires release verification.
`/api/volunteer` GET
County and comma-separated causes; defaults county from profile; returns matched organization rows
Reuse directory and matching. A returned empty list with an unavailable note currently differs from a proven no-match result.
`/api/learn` GET
`topic`, `locale`, plus factor-specific context query fields; returns definition, reading-specific explanation, one applicable household note, protective steps and sources
Existing seven topics and English fallback remain. New multiple-category guidance, glossary search and additional domains require additive contracts.
`/api/assistant` GET and POST
GET page suggestions; POST `question` up to 1,000 characters and optional allowlisted `page`; one cited answer or refusal/unavailable result
No current conversation, upload, selected-record or mutation-tool contract. Household context is assembled server-side. Do not attach private text to GET query parameters.
`/api/alerts` GET and POST
GET latest 100 undismissed alerts and unread count in that returned set; POST one read, all read, or one dismissed boolean
Owner scoped and updated count returned. New global unread count/cursor pagination is an explicit addition. Dismissal is not deletion or task completion.
`/api/notifications` GET and PUT
Five booleans: `air_quality_change`, `weather_advisory`, `new_water_results`, `radon_season`, `season_summary`; PUT accepts a partial preferences object
Existing false preference suppresses both inbox creation and push. Channel-specific controls need defined migration, not a frontend-only reinterpretation.
`/api/push/subscribe` POST and DELETE
Browser subscription JSON, or DELETE `{endpoint}`

Endpoint unique; subscription upsert currently reassigns an existing endpoint to the current verified user. Rebinding and multi-device tests must prevent old-household notifications on a reused device.
`/api/sources` GET
Source list and last retrieved values composed from household history and reference datasets
Retrieval metadata is not observation date. Add registry/source-revision detail without breaking the existing list.
`/api/account` DELETE
Literal `{confirm: "DELETE"}` then auth-admin user deletion
Current cascade-based delete has no file/job/export lifecycle. Extend deletion before enabling those domains.
`/api/health` GET
Authenticated fixed-location probes of providers, database and Redis
Does not prove valid schemas, source freshness, corpus quality, migrations, deployed scheduler, or successful end-to-end workflows. Bound and restrict probe cost before operational use.
`/api/cron/daily` GET and POST
Header or legacy query scheduler secret; geography/layers, water-change detection, daily readings, alerts, push
Keep one authorized scheduler entry point while moving expensive work into resumable batches. Never invoke against production as a harmless health check.
`auth.users`, `profiles`, `household_bands`
Same anonymous identity and household category model; additive home contexts and consent records
`profiles.id` matches the auth identity today. New recovery or membership cannot casually rekey every row.
`daily_scores`, `home_risks`
Preserve owned history/cascades and any deployed dependencies; inspect actual use before migration
Daily scores allow multiple writes per date, with newest chosen for history. Do not add date-only uniqueness that loses legitimate revisions.
`ucmr5_utilities`, geography cache, reference JSON
Retain import and presentation adapters; add sample provenance and qualified evidence revisions
Existing detections and boundary matches do not prove complete tested denominators or household exposure.
`symptom_logs`
Same original Journal records and uniqueness
Preserve note, illness, retrospective, category and dates through migration and export.
`volunteer_orgs`, `learn_content`
Extend existing curated catalogs with explicit publication/review/version metadata
Directory name uniqueness is not a permanent source identity. Published guidance and translations need revision history.
`alerts`, `notification_prefs`, `push_subscriptions`, `water_snapshots`
Existing inbox and push delivery form the one notification subsystem
Add subscriptions, delivery attempts and outbox rather than a second inbox; migrate old preference semantics deliberately.
`map_layers`, `lib/mapBuild.js`, `lib/districtView.js`
Reuse canonical spatial assembly and district calculations
Current stored layers age out after 36 hours and public layer queries are capped. Real source freshness differs by layer.
`assistant_corpus`, `match_assistant_corpus`, `lib/assistantRag.js`
Same curated retrieval foundation, source citations and refusal path
Migration 0013 changes embeddings to 2,048 dimensions. Model, dimensions, stored vectors and RPC must match; adding food/garden material needs reviewed source ingestion.
`lib/actionPlan.js`, `lib/wellTestData.js`, `lib/explain.js`
Seed versioned action templates and explanations from reviewed existing logic
These generate recommendations, not persistent user actions. P02 adds follow-through, not a second competing recommendation engine.
`lib/serverAuth.js`, `lib/authResult.js`, `lib/ratelimit.js`
Verified identity, 401 versus503 handling, rate/spend guards
Service-role access bypasses RLS. Every query and nested record must still be authorized in the server.
Identity
Stable evidence ID, revision, domain, source record ID, and any superseded record ID
Value
Original value and unit, normalized value and unit when valid, parameter or analyte, and explicit reporting qualifier
Evidence type
Observed, modelled, forecast, proxy, official advisory, user reported, laboratory document, or reviewed guidance
Time
Observation or sample time, publication time, provider issue time when relevant, ingestion time, and validity interval. These must not be substituted for each other.
Geography
Point, monitor area, utility service area, county, waterbody segment, district, site, or unknown. Include geometry version and association method.
Coverage
Parameters available and missing, reporting limits, sampling coverage, and known exclusions
Provenance
Source ID, exact supporting URL or document locator, method version, transformation version, and retrieval record
Interpretation
Severity where a defensible rule exists, threshold or guidance reference, effective date, and applicability conditions
Freshness
Source-specific current, stale, superseded, expired, unavailable, or unknown state with a reason

Existing AirNow lookup with Open-Meteo model fallback

Preserve measured versus modelled. Verify observation timestamps, reporting area, parameter coverage, licensing, and permitted forecast access before increasing polling. Source S04 documents the one-to-five-day request range and current non-EEA retention exceptions: today's values 365 days, other forecast/heatmap values 24 hours. Version and review the heuristic. It is not a measurement of outdoor spores or indoor mold. No background illustration or wording may imply detection.

cells: Radon and lead

Retain geography and estimate basis. Add household test evidence separately. Verify dataset versions and any source-specific limits.

cells: Official alerts

cells: Fish advisories
State health agency public ArcGIS records plus reviewed official documents

headings: Typed field requirements for new flows
cells: Source review X07
Source/run/revision ID, reviewer role, validated publish/withdraw decision and rationale
Atomic published pointer, superseded history, affected-entity event and audit record. An editor cannot publish unvalidated raw import text as advice by merely checking a box.
Source and ingestion run
Source has many runs; run keyed by source/release/parser request; external record stable within its source namespace
Service/operator writes. Public reads expose approved metadata only, never credentials, fetch headers or raw private data.
Evidence and revisions
Evidence identity unique by source and stable source record key; revision keyed by canonical content hash plus source revision semantics; current pointer references validated revision
Published public records are read-only to ordinary users. Private measurements remain in owned domains, not a public evidence table row with a forgotten flag.
Guidance and project templates
Topic/template, locale and version; published version has sources and review record
Ordinary users read published only. Withdrawal preserves referenced history while blocking new recommendations.
Home context
Many per profile, at most one current context; effective dates cannot overlap for current-home interpretation
Ownership enforced; archiving is not deletion. Full deletion includes all historical contexts.
Household action
Many per profile; optional parent/project must share owner; optional evidence references public reviewed revisions or owned private record
Parent completion does not silently complete children. Delete/archive policy handles children and linked tests explicitly.
Recommendation preference
Unique owner/recommendation/context/version scope; disposition plus validity/review date and optional linked canonical action
Reversible owner control. Suppression and Already doing this never write a completion or hide an official notice; full deletion includes these records.
Occurrence and reminder
Unique action/series-version/local occurrence key; unique occurrence/channel/reminder kind; store original timezone/fold decision
Server generates, owner changes authorized schedule; cancellation immediately invalidates future delivery intent.
Outdoor plan and forecast watch
Owned plan has one canonical action; watch unique per plan/factor/policy and references supported forecast area/time
Server may flag review, not change selected interval. Removing plan cancels watches and reminder jobs.
Test and results
Test belongs to context or garden site; many analytes and corrected revisions; result sequence unique within test
No one-result-per-analyte constraint if a report has multiple sample points. Corrections supersede but do not overwrite original evidence.
Assets and maintenance
Owned asset, service records and linked shared actions; replacement can archive one asset and start another
Cascades/explicit unlink must not erase an unrelated laboratory result. Cleanup handles attachments and reminders.
Garden and site context
Many optional sites per profile; irrigation/source context versioned; observations/tests retain original context
Do not require unique site labels or use labels as IDs. Delete offers clear linked-record scope.
Advisory and audience rules
Issuer/advisory source ID plus version; many species groups, extents and audience/combined-limit rules
Public reviewed reads; no household consumption data in rules. Withdrawal creates a change event.
Fish and water-use records
Many private observations; source/advisory links optional; revision checked
Do not prohibit legitimate same-day records with a day-only uniqueness key. Delete/export includes notes and owned files.
Opportunity and participation
Public opportunity has organizer and revisions; participation unique by household/opportunity except distinct sessions explicitly modelled
Attendance not inferred from opening a link. Cancelled source retains saved participation context.
Outreach and observations
Owner, optional context, selected evidence revisions, snapshots and shared follow-up actions
External-sent snapshot immutable to edits; draft and later amendments separate. Default remains private.
Attachment
Owner, private object key, checksum, MIME, byte count, scan state, sanitized derivative references and typed domain binding
Foreign-owner linking blocked. Deletion considers originals, thumbnails, extraction output and temporary upload objects.
Subscription and event
Subscription unique by owner/entity/type/parameter set; source event unique by entity/revision/event kind
Viewing is never subscription. All jobs recheck cancelled status and current preferences before delivery.
Outbox and delivery attempt
Outbox intent keyed by target household/event; channel/device attempts keyed by outbox/channel/device revision
Service-only leasing; repeated execution safe. Public logs contain IDs and error codes, not private notification bodies.
Luna session and proposal
Owner-scoped conversation; proposal references authorized context and expires; confirmation nonce single-use
Provider processing and local/server storage are distinct choices. Private free-text Journal notes excluded by default.
Export and deletion job
Owner/request hash/idempotency scope; export manifest and expiry; deletion retains minimal non-content completion marker
No private job result accessible using guessable ID. Deletion status needs a narrow authenticated or scoped receipt flow after auth deletion.
Source acquisition
Source-defined next check or explicit operator run; source/release/request key
Use permitted conditional requests, explicit timeout and redirect policy. Store the run and raw/hashed acquisition evidence before parser publication. A partial page never becomes a complete dataset.
Validation and publication
Completed acquisition run plus parser/method version
Check required fields, count changes, units, geography and dates; quarantine suspect runs; publish canonical revision and change event transactionally.
Public derived views
Published compatible source versions; layer or aggregate/version key
Rebuild Map/district/forecast indexes in bounded batches. Persist assembled-at and original source times independently; keep previous compatible version until success.
Household history and matching
Regional observation/source event plus stable home-context ID
Batch by eligible context and permitted shared spatial resolution; persist cursor; preserve actual capture basis; match subscriptions before fanout. Recheck context when executing.
Reminder generation
Scheduled scan and completion-relative event; action/series/occurrence key

Materialize a bounded horizon, preserve all-day versus timed semantics, respect timezone and quiet hours, and cancel superseded occurrences. Never replay an obsolete safety-related reminder as timely.
Alert fanout
Published source event plus matching policy version; household/event key
Recheck ownership, watch state, current consent/preferences and supported scope. Fanout resumes per checkpoint. Event retained until all intended batches reconcile.
Push delivery
Committed outbox item and allowed device/channel
Record attempts, retry transient provider failures, retire 404/410 endpoints, respect expiry and quiet hours. Accepted push is not proof the person read it.
Content and link review
Source/template next review date or manual report
Queue a curator review; HTTP 200 is only link reachability. Source changes do not auto-publish new interpretation or translations.
Export and deletion cleanup
User-confirmed job or retention expiry
Verify owner and current status at every step; remove temporary files; bounded retries and operator-visible failure. No sensitive payload in queue logs.
Current outdoor conditions
Shared cache refreshed within an appropriate 15 to 60 minute window while used, with measured provider cadence respected
Latest available observation or model output, with its actual time
Forecasts
Refresh near provider releases or on stale reads, not once per household request
Forecast issued at a stated time, valid for stated periods
Urgent official advisories
Frequent polling or supported feed delivery only where operationally sustainable
Last checked time and link to official instructions; HALO is not an emergency dispatch service
Utility laboratory results
Check source releases or scheduled imports; notify after validated new records
New published evidence, not continuous tap monitoring
Fish and food advisories
Check official sources on a reviewed schedule, with human review when automated interpretation is unsafe
Current known advisory and last verification, not continuous food testing
Drought and conservation notices
Ingest drought on its actual weekly publication cycle; check utility notices on a separately verified schedule
Regional drought and utility restrictions are distinct, with their own dates and scope
Conservation events
Recheck approaching events and source changes more often than distant records
Organizer information can change; registration is confirmed by the organizer
Tests and maintenance
Monitor household-record states and chosen reminders
HALO tracks the process and reported result, not an absent physical sensor
Gardens
Track official updates, entered observations, recorded tests, and chosen tasks
No claim to continuously detect soil or crop chemistry
Household profile and category records
Retained while the household is active; editable; removed through full deletion
Current identity, old home contexts and linked records cannot survive invisibly outside documented retention.
Journal and private home records
Retained until user deletion or clearly disclosed inactivity policy; distinct Clear Journal scope
Export and deletion list actual rows, derived findings and attachments. Inactivity purge cannot surprise a user with valuable records.
Chat
Default no durable transcript beyond the selected session unless history is explicitly enabled
UI states actual server/browser/provider retention separately. Provider policy is reviewed, not inferred from no local table.
Local drafts
Session-only by default; optional device persistence requires disclosure and identity binding
Clear/logout/delete removes owned drafts and sensitive caches. Shared devices do not reveal a former identity's draft.
Temporary uploads and export artifacts
Short configured expiry and scheduled cleanup, with cancel/delete available
Interrupted uploads, derivative files and expired downloads are actually removed; signed URL expiry alone is not deletion.
Notifications and action audit
Bounded private history with explicit archive/delete policy
Read/dismiss/expiry semantics do not leave hidden sensitive payloads in a separate log forever.
Public evidence and guidance revisions
Retained as needed for provenance and referenced history within source terms
Licensing/retraction rules are obeyed and withdrawn content is not reused as current guidance.
Operational logs and job receipts
Short, minimized retention; identifiers/error codes rather than private content
Access limited to operators, retention configured and reviewed, diagnostic output does not leak provider secrets.
Backups
Provider-specific window documented separately from active-record deletion
Restore procedure reapplies deletions/tombstones before restored data becomes accessible; recovery window and file coverage tested.
Supabase
`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`; anonymous bootstrap and `requireUser`
Separate development/staging/production projects or demonstrably isolated test identities; anonymous auth/CAPTCHA policy; RLS on all private tables; key rotation and no client secret bundle.
Human verification
`NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` and provider-side auth configuration
Domain allowlist and challenge verification actually work; inaccessible challenge has a supported recovery path, not silent bypass.
Geocoding and map
`MAPBOX_TOKEN`, ArcGIS adapter; production renderer chosen separately

Server geocoding credential permissions/quotas, public rendering token if needed restricted by origin/scope, attribution, allowed cache and data terms. No reuse of a private server token in a client renderer.
Environmental providers
`AIRNOW_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_POLLEN_API_KEY`, existing Open-Meteo/NWS/OpenUV adapter paths

Verify keys/access, API shape, supported geography, polling limits, declared units/source times and fallback behavior for each adapter. Review any hardcoded provider configuration without exposing it in logs.
Redis and budget guards
`UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL`, `UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN`, current limiter policies
Connectivity and scopes, shared cache persistence/TTL, circuit breakers and fail-open versus fail-closed spending consequences. Anonymous identity creation is not itself an abuse limit.
Luna provider
`ASSISTANT_MODEL_KEY` or `OPENAI_API_KEY`; `ASSISTANT_CHAT_URL`, `ASSISTANT_CHAT_MODEL`, `ASSISTANT_CHAT_FALLBACK_MODELS`, `ASSISTANT_EMBED_URL`, `ASSISTANT_EMBED_MODEL`, `ASSISTANT_EMBED_DIM`

Approved provider processing policy and permitted domains, model/token costs, timeouts and citation tests; model/dimension/corpus/RPC compatibility and retained provenance. Do not switch providers as an undisclosed privacy fallback.
Luna privacy and spending
`ASSISTANT_SEND_HOUSEHOLD_CONTEXT`, `ASSISTANT_GLOBAL_DAILY_LIMIT`

Explicit effective configuration returned to clients; missing context flag currently enables context. Proposed user consent must be enforced server-side. Global cap retains fail-closed behavior when budget service fails.
Push
`VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY`, `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY`, `VAPID_SUBJECT`; browser uses the corresponding public application-server key

Public/private pair, secure service-worker scope, allowlisted notification destinations, subscription lifecycle, browser/platform support and physical-device delivery tests. Backend sender existing does not prove every frontend registration path exists.
Scheduler
`CRON_SECRET`, `vercel.json`, current 60-second maximum routes
Host actually dispatches authorized jobs on the supported schedule. Prefer header secret, retire logged query-secret use carefully. New reminder cadence needs real scheduler capacity.
Previews and isolated tests
`HALO_ENABLE_FRONTEND_PREVIEW`, `HALO_STAGE_TEST`, fixture routes and isolated build output
No fixture payload on live routes, no test writes to shared production, previews cannot become an authentication bypass or leak private state.
Proposed platform additions
Private storage buckets, queue/lease tables, source flags, retention settings, content-review roles
Configure only when the corresponding feature is enabled; stage secret rotation, backup, dead-letter review and rollback before taking user records. These are not existing deployed capabilities.

cells: Chemical identity
Maintain source label plus reviewed analyte identifier/aliases. PFAS is a family, not one interchangeable measured substance. Preserve mixtures and method scope.
Units and sample matrix

Retain raw text/unit/qualifier. Normalization includes conversion version and matrix. Water mass-per-volume, soil mass-per-mass and food tissue results cannot share one automatic threshold. Wet/dry basis and nondetect limits remain explicit.
Time

Distinguish sample/observation, issue, valid, publication, retrieval and review times. Preserve date-only records as dates and user schedules with IANA time zone. Never invent midnight UTC observation time.
Identity

Namespace PWSIDs, station IDs, facility registry IDs, advisory IDs, programme IDs and source row keys. Preserve raw values and reviewed crosswalks. Fuzzy names can suggest candidates, not confirm identity.
Geography

Store point/area/segment plus CRS, geometry release and matching method. Source point, centroid and buffer are not exposure boundaries. Keep approximate user context separate from public source geography.
Completeness

Know which pages/files/parameters were fetched. Distinguish not tested, nondetect, no coverage, fetch failure, stale, withdrawn and valid zero. No record count becomes a testing denominator without its population definition.
Corrections

A new revision can correct metadata without indicating worsening conditions. Saved tasks retain evidence snapshots and flag material changes. Withdrawal invalidates current guidance but preserves provenance.
Scope
No household location inference from event attendance, no pregnancy/age inference from general categories, no food inference from water, no agency receipt from an opened link.

New private observations/files/destination directory. Cause remains unknown unless evidence supports it. No automatic public map, agency receipt or unsafe collection prompt.
M01 Map
Full focused map, four layer controls, zoom/locate/pan, accessible search/list, legend, selected-record sheet, preserved view and failure fallback
Existing backend layers; production renderer/client still needed. Lazy load. Each layer has independent loading/error. Unlocated records remain in list.
M02 Water timeline
Overall/compound/hazard selector, Latest versus source quarters, marker/detail/sample rows, own-system ring, watch/action/compare links
Existing map source extended for complete sampling metadata. Failed quarter restores prior selection; stale response cannot override new filter. Density labelled record density, not plume.
M03 Other layers
Radon county details/test link; facilities clusters, compliance programs and official record; air monitor pollutant/time/provenance
Existing layers with source metadata and honest nulls. Map symbols distinguish evidence types. Fish/drought overlays only after geography gate, not merely decorative colored polygons.
M04 Comparison
Select second compatible public record, aligned values/units/dates/coverage, missing reasons, source drilldown, clear comparison/back
New comparison adapter/query over normalized evidence. Mobile list rather than two tiny maps. Disable unsupported comparisons with reason, not rank missing as best.
M05 District
District/state summary, compound control, denominator explanation, county rows/partial tags, supported rank, unlocated coverage, public export/outreach
Existing district aggregation extended/verified. Boundary version visible; people served are not proven exposed. Never include household location/private data in a public brief.
P01 Your Week
Week/day controls, agenda, unscheduled list, overdue/upcoming/waiting groups, filters, optional month jump, item detail, calendar export
New plan/action/occurrence service. All-day dates distinct from instants. Event update affects same record everywhere; calendar download is not sync.
P02 Shared actions
Save sheet, existing-action match, editable detail, steps/reason/source, schedule/status/follow-up, complete/reopen/cancel/delete
New owned actions with evidence/context/revision/idempotency. Same ID across every entrance. Mark waiting does not invent a due date or completed result.
P03 Outdoor plans
Activity/place/duration/date form, comparable forecast-period chooser, per-factor tradeoffs, official notice, preparation, save/watch/reschedule
New normalized forecast/plan service. Per-source horizon and resolution visible; far future means check later. No safe-time score, route tracking or automatic rescheduling.
P04 Journal
First-use retrospective or Log today, date/category picker, symptoms/severity/illness/note or Felt fine, save/update, recent list, delete/undo, partial batch retry
Existing Journal endpoints need production client/screens and stronger logging semantics. Current upsert replaces whole entry; do not send unloaded blanks. Original fields survive edits.
P05 Patterns
Twelve-week heat grid and list, factor/date/category controls, day detail, chart/table, findings/counts/method, edit selected entry and export
Existing history/findings with revised analysis contract. Explicit logged versus unlogged, recalled, illness and missing-data counts; no causal conclusion. Unsupported filters not merely cosmetic.
P06 Seasonal recap
Season selector, coverage summary, environmental trends, logged entries/actions/tests/participation, source detail, dismiss prompt, export and next review
Existing summary plus owned record joins and revised analysis. No engagement streak or inferred benefit. Alert deep-link opens actual season.
X01 Learn and sources
Inline definition, contextual explanation, reviewed topic index/search, full topic/source detail, linked practical action and return
Existing seven-topic Learn plus proposed index/versioned content. Retain form drafts; search has empty/failure states. Review dates and precise supporting sources visible.
X02 Luna
Approved launcher/panel, context disclosure, suggestions, composer/send/cancel/retry/new conversation, citations, proposed action/draft preview and explicit confirmation
Existing assistant with new capabilities/context/conversation/proposal contracts. No fake streaming, hidden household context, unsupported paperclip or automatic effects.
X03 Alerts and watchlists
Inbox/unread, expand, read one/all, dismiss/undo, exact target; follows list/detail, channels, reminder snooze, quiet-time controls
Existing alerts/notifications/push plus typed subscriptions and event targets. Browser permission states explicit. Read is not task completion; cancelled event is retained with notice.
X04 Settings
Sections for household/home/address/renter mode, notifications, accessibility, reviewed language, privacy, recovery, sources/methods/About/feedback
Existing essential Settings plus new preference contracts. Explicit Save, fresh preflight, conflict and retained drafts. No appearance switch unless separately approved.
X05 Privacy and recovery
Stored-data inspector, scoped export, clear Journal, delete all, optional recovery/link flow, device/session list and revoke where supported
Existing deletion extended to all domains; new exports/recovery. Explain current anonymous-session loss honestly. Typed confirmation and operation-status recovery for destructive actions.
X06 Offline and accessibility
Cross-app offline/stale badges, retry/draft status, motion pause, high-contrast/text controls, text chart/map/calendar alternatives

Existing environmental cache/accessibility foundation, extended per feature. Private offline writes are not implicitly implemented; queued is not saved. No feature requires animation, hover or gestures.
X07 Source operations
Protected operator list/detail for freshness/failure/review, import diff/quarantine, publish/withdraw, translation review and job retry
New internal role-protected UI or equivalent documented admin workflow. No ordinary-user link or service key in browser. Publication/retry has audit reason, expected revision and explicit scope.

cells: G01 Onboarding

Preserve approved layout and handwriting; support address, US ZIP and voluntary GPS without automatic permission requests; keep data on Back and failed save; confirm ambiguous writes using request identifiers; use authoritative completion state; distinguish out-of-region coverage from lookup failure; continue honestly when a provider cannot return a result. cells: T01 Today overview

Four factors only, fixed card order, real source timestamps, explicit partial coverage, unknown distinct from zero, proper refresh cooldown, cached-reading notice, and meaningful change comparison using compatible time, coverage and methodology. A source arriving after an outage must not be described as worsening conditions. Ring and contributions must not claim percentages of health risk or formula weights when only visual input shares exist.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan

cells: T02 Air

Show real AQI and dominant pollutant when provided, observation context, provenance, seven-day gaps, accessible chart data, and a link to the relevant monitor/map context. Save an applicable step into the shared action system and return to the same detail position. Unknown provenance is neither measured nor modelled.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan

cells: T03 UV

Preserve rising-sun composition; distinguish observed/current reading, daily maximum and forecast window; include timezone and forecast issue time when supplied; allow inspecting a supported time and saving a chosen step. A null window must not imply low UV all day. Do not fill unavailable forecast hours with interpolated values.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: T04 Pollen

Show tree, grass and weed separately with units or category definitions, source coverage and dominant category. Changing category updates its chart and accessible summary together. Seasonal text is reviewed and geographically appropriate, not a replacement for current data. Link to optional Journal without suggesting pollen caused a reported symptom.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: T05 Mold

Explicitly label the current weather-based estimate; show humidity/rainfall basis only when present; offer moisture-check guidance and records without claiming indoor spore detection. If users later enter sensor readings or observations, maintain their separate origin, units, timestamps and scope.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: T06 Daily family

Selected categories and general guidance both work; combine applicable messages without duplicate instructions or conflicting priorities; explain which environmental evidence prompted a suggestion; save the same action record used elsewhere. headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan

cells: H01 Homeguard

Preserve home score semantics, separate evidence gaps, selected-category house, water/radon/lead routing and ranked actions. Clicking a house figure opens its category guide with a reliable return path. Private water has a testing pathway, not an invented water or combined score. A completed action does not change a measurement or score without new evidence.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H02 Water

Show matched utility and mapping limitations; support complete, partial, no detections recorded, excluded-only, unscoreable, no published result, failed lookup, no utility match and private-source states distinctly. Retain compound units, sample dates, history, enforceable limit versus benchmark, unregulated/excluded evidence and source revision. Follow the utility, inspect on Map, start a test, or prepare outreach using the exact selected record. Do not label a detection-only source as complete testing coverage.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H03 Radon

Keep county potential separate from a household concentration. Testing workflow supports planned, awaiting result, result recorded, review and follow-up states. Result units, method, start/end dates and source are required as appropriate. Guidance and reminder timing must be source-reviewed; a saved test suppresses an obsolete no-test reminder only under an explicit rule.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H04 Lead

Keep age estimate and utility service-line totals distinct from property evidence; show unscored status permanently. Unknown year is not newer construction. User-supplied or verified property information is separately identified. Routes to home correction, testing, certification guidance and renter outreach retain context.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H05 Household guides

Only selected categories appear in the house; direct URLs for unavailable categories have a clear general-guidance or edit-selection explanation, not fixture people. General child/teen/adult guidance remains supported. Clinical-sounding age-specific claims need reviewed sources. Category overlap must not become a false count of residents.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H06 Tests and records

Create, edit, archive/delete and inspect a test record; retain test type, purpose, dates, lab/provider or user origin, specimen/site context, units, result qualifiers, reporting limits, attachments if supported, review status and related actions. Draft, ordered or arranged, sampled, awaiting result, recorded and follow-up are distinct. Pending tests are not negative results. Uploaded extraction is unconfirmed until the user verifies it.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H07 Maintenance

Save specific equipment or upkeep information only when useful; retain installation/service dates, product or source instructions, user-chosen cadence, last completion and next due. Snooze, skip, complete, change cadence and stop reminders without losing history. A filter replacement reminder neither verifies the product's certification nor proves contaminant reduction.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: H08 Household summary

Preview and choose included evidence; retain original two-score/all-factor/source/top-action capability; identify missing, old, estimated and user-reported information; private-water version shows tests rather than no action. Print cleanly in light black-on-white with no app chrome, use readable labels rather than color alone, and support image export with permission/error fallbacks. Export generation date must not replace observation dates. Sharing is explicit and excludes sensitive additions by default.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: F02 Fish advisories

Resolve a selected waterbody and species against the actual advisory geography and audience categories. Distinguish statewide from specific advice, effective from superseded records, no matching advisory from known unrestricted status, and source outage from no advisory. Show the exact official recommendation with units and qualifications; save/follow it and alert on meaningful revisions. Existing household category labels must not silently approximate advisory age or audience definitions. Optional catch/consumption notes support private create/edit/delete/export with original dates, species, waterbody and quantity/unit; they do not compute dose or remaining allowances and are not required for advisory access.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: F03 Garden records and guidance

Optional setup captures relevant growing-site, water-source and test context without requiring names or exact residential coordinates. Guide the user to suitable sampling/resources, connect test results and chosen stewardship tasks, and retain useful notes over time. Routine fertility testing is not contaminant testing. Regional water or soil data cannot become a measurement of the plot or crop.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: F04 Local food information

Distinguish local official notices, product/sample-specific tests, broader monitoring and research. Filter by supported geography or product category without claiming every local food is covered. Users can inspect source and sample date, save/follow a specific notice, prepare questions and record their own relevant source-linked information. No universal PFAS food score, product absence-as-safe claim, or unsupported farm contamination inference.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: F05 Grower resources

Support genuinely useful water/soil sampling preparation, relevant Extension and testing contacts, source-linked records and conservation program details. Separate growing sites only where needed, with accessible labels and optional coarse location. A grower can save a resource, prepare questions, attach a confirmed test and plan a follow-up. Do not give crop-specific agronomic prescriptions without suitable evidence and review.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: F06 Water stewardship

Show dated US Drought Monitor county category distributions, or a point classification only when a valid dated source geometry supports it; never use the county maximum as the home's status. Separately show source-dated utility conservation notices where verified ingestion exists. Regional drought, enforceable or voluntary utility notice, and plot moisture are different facts. Optional meter/bill/irrigation records require units, period, source and edit history. Compare only compatible measured periods; identify estimated entries and interval length. Report measured usage difference, not savings caused by HALO or a task without a validated attribution method. Do not infer moisture or irrigation quantities from a regional drought class.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan

cells: A01 Act hub

Keep original organizations, ways to help, letters and household summary reachable while introducing conservation depth. Personalization explains relevance but does not prevent browsing another cause. Local issue pages connect evidence to organizations, projects, outreach and Map. Good or missing readings do not leave the page empty.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: A02 Organizations

Preserve county/served-area and cause matching, actual contact/site links, human verification status and date. Working URLs are not proof of organizational verification. Distinguish no matches, unsupported geography, stale records and failed request. Users can broaden filters and report stale listing information without creating a public accusation.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: A03 Opportunities

Distinguish an organization from a dated opportunity. Show organizer, actual place/service area, time and timezone, requirements, accessibility information when supplied, cost, age restrictions and registration link. Saving to Plan does not register; clicking registration does not prove completion. Support cancelled, full, postponed, date changed, unknown capacity and expired states, with change notices for saved events.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: A04 Stewardship projects

A project has a reviewed purpose, suitability, materials, real ordered steps, constraints, completion criteria and follow-up. Save once into Plan, record progress and stop or revise it. Count user-reported actions as participation, not measured pollution removal or health improvement. Source-backed protocols are required before describing observations as monitoring data.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: A05 Outreach

Keep Utility, Landlord and Representative recipients with separate draft edits and current-recipient reset. Show cited evidence and applicable legal versus benchmark status. Include information-request/testing variants when no exceedance is established and hide irrelevant utility templates for wells. Copy and share have permission, cancellation and unsupported-device fallbacks. An outbound click is not sent status; sending and replies are user-confirmed unless a verified integration exists. Recipient discovery and legal guidance require reliable current sources.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: A06 Private field observations

Users can privately record a date/time, observation category, factual description, optional coarse location and optional photo. Do not infer a contaminant from appearance or odor. Provide export and an official-reporting handoff, not automatic submission or publication on a shared map. Strip or explicitly protect precise photo metadata and exact location; preview what leaves the app. Status distinguishes draft, exported, official site opened and user-confirmed report. Emergency situations point to appropriate official channels, not Luna.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: M01 Map shell

Preserve four layer controls, pan, zoom, touch/pinch, keyboard controls, locate, home context, attribution, legend, selection, independent layer failure and renderer fallback. Accessible searchable text list works without the map and includes records lacking coordinates. Lazy loading and responsive layout preserve the rest of the app.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: M02 Water and timeline

Preserve compound selectors, Overall and hazard index, own-system ring, population/null handling, complete selected-record detail, available quarters plus distinct Latest, loading retention, cancellation and failed-quarter restoration. Latest is each system's latest observation, not a single synchronized date. Empty quarter differs from no stored detections. Historical sample points do not describe a moving plume.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: M03 Other layers

Radon county polygons show zone context, never home concentration; facilities preserve selected-dataset scope, compliance-program counts, inspection/date/null and grouped points; air stations show observation time, pollutant/source and approximate distance. Missing or filtered-out dots never mean clean geography.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: M04 Comparisons

Compare only like units, periods, evidence kinds, denominator definitions and geographic scopes. Display coverage and date differences before interpreting them. Household rank uses its actual ranked denominator and hides when unranked. Public-system comparison never implies residents can choose their supplier. A smooth density display is labelled record density, not pollution intensity.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: M05 District

Preserve district/state summary, county rows including partial-county tags, compound-specific denominators, affected-population completeness, unlocated records and boundary version. Avoid misidentifying a household district from a partially included county. System centroids do not establish exact service-area membership. Geography failure is distinct from zero exceedances.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: P01 Your Week

Show saved actions, routines, tests, events and optional outdoor plans in one agenda with accessible date navigation. Permit unscheduled saves. Preserve all-day dates versus timed events, timezone changes and daylight-saving transitions. Rescheduling an item updates the shared record, not an unrelated calendar copy. Clearly label a calendar export as an export unless synchronization actually exists.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: P02 Shared actions

Save from any relevant screen; deduplicate the same action under explicit rules; retain origin, reason, evidence version, user edits, chosen due date and status. Create, edit, schedule, snooze, complete, reopen, archive/delete and review changed source guidance. Duplicate taps, retries and unknown-write outcomes do not create duplicate reminders or false completion.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: P03 Outdoor planning

Ask only useful activity, place, date and time information; show supported per-factor forecasts, issue time, horizon, uncertainty and missing periods. Compare practical options with tradeoffs rather than an unvalidated safest-time score. Expired forecasts require review. No continuous background location tracking or inference that a user was exposed at a planned place.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: P04 Journal

Preserve first-use retrospective, Log today instead, past dates, group selector, seven symptom labels, severity without a default, possible illness, optional note, felt-fine action, recent entries, prefilled update, visible delete and undo. Guard against blank overwrites while entries load. Retrospective batch retry sends only failed days and preserves existing records; a blank day is not a felt-fine day. A useful immediate result can be descriptive environmental context, including insufficient data.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: P05 Patterns

Preserve twelve-week heat grid, missing-factor mark, accessible legend, per-day readings and logged entries, edit-from-day detail, score trend, finding bars and counts, and optional group filtering. Logged counts, comparable counts and environmental-history counts are distinct. Revised symptom comparisons must distinguish unlogged and explicitly fine days, retrospective recollection, illness flags and missing readings. Show sample sizes, method and limits; no causation or diagnostic conclusion.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: P06 Seasonal recap

Retain season summaries and dismissible relevant prompts without streaks or pressure. Alert links open the actual recap. Show period, logged-day coverage, environmental coverage, excluded days and limits. Show completed actions as user-reported follow-through, not proof that those actions changed health or environmental conditions.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X01 Learn

Retain reading-specific explanation, what it is, why this reading, household relevance, concrete protective steps and dated source links. Integrate it into factor/feature details rather than recreating a competing tab. Omit unsupported personalized sections instead of filler. The proposed glossary/topic index is a new addition, with entry from contextual Learn or Sources and methods, search over reviewed topics, clear no-match behavior and return-to-context. New food/garden topics require new supported content contracts and reviewed translations.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X02 Luna

Preserve approved name/visuals, suggestions, grounded replies, citations, refusal, no-source, unavailable, unconfigured, rate-limit, cancel and retry states. New conversation context and action tools are explicit backend extensions. Server derives authorized household context; show real controls and provider-use status before implying privacy. Draft actions require preview and confirmation. Cancel/retry does not duplicate a message or execute an action twice. Do not promise diagnosis, treatment or arbitrary live web knowledge.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X03 Alerts and watchlists

Preserve unread badge, read one/all, full-message expansion, explicit related-page link, dismiss and undo. Support the original five preference types plus separately reviewed subscriptions/reminders. Meaningful changes deduplicate by event and evidence version. Marking an alert read differs from acknowledging an action; opening inbox alone does not clear all unread items. Push is opt-in and unsupported browsers still have an inbox.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X04 Settings

Retain full household edit, home details, confirmed address change, renter/owner mode, accessibility, notification preferences, reviewed language, privacy, About, dynamic source list and methodology. Explicit saves preserve drafts and untouched fields across refetches. A household replacement always contains all seven booleans. Unknown profile state disables writes. No product appearance picker unless separately approved.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X05 Privacy and recovery

Inspect stored values and categories, export selected/all supported data, clear Journal with a real count, and delete all household data with typed confirmation. Deletion covers new tables, private files, queues, subscriptions and derived caches, with honest provider-retention limits. Optional recovery or device linking requires dedicated secure design and consent; anonymous use remains viable.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X06 Offline and accessibility

Cached evidence keeps original source dates and visible offline status; new private records are not silently cached. If offline drafts or queues are implemented, label pending/unconfirmed state, provide cancel, and synchronize only for the same verified identity. Every key action has keyboard and screen-reader equivalents; reduced motion and large text remain functional.

headings: HALO Feature Preservation and Acceptance Plan
headers: Required behavior and evidence of completion
cells: X07 Source operations

Each external feed and curated resource has an owner, coverage, update expectation, source date, last successful fetch, review status and failure behavior. A feed outage cannot publish an empty replacement as clean conditions. Changed or retracted advice links to affected saved actions for review. No user-facing monitoring promise before source access and refresh reliability are demonstrated.
